SELECT p.project_id AS projectId, p.client_id AS clientId, p.title AS title, p.description AS description, p.start_date AS startDate, p.deadline_date AS deadlineDate, p.est_duration AS estDuration, p.budget AS budget, p.communicate_method AS communicateMethod, p.payment_method AS paymentMethod, p.project_status AS projectStatus, p.is_public AS isPublic, p.created_at AS createdAt, p.view_count AS viewCount, p.applicant_count AS applicantCount, p.budget_negotiable AS budgetNegotiable, p.duration_negotiable AS durationNegotiable, p.plan_url AS planUrl,
(SELECT stack_level FROM project_stacks WHERE project_id = p.project_id LIMIT 1) AS minLevel,
(SELECT stack_year FROM project_stacks WHERE project_id = p.project_id LIMIT 1) AS minYear, p.max_revision_count AS maxRevisionCount, p.change_policy AS changePolicy,
u.name AS clientName, c.company_name AS companyName, cp.client_type AS clientType, c.industry AS companyIndustry
FROM projects p JOIN users u ON u.user_id = p.client_id LEFT JOIN client_profiles cp ON cp.client_id = p.client_id LEFT JOIN companies c ON c.company_id = cp.company_id WHERE p.project_id = #{projectId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO project_applications (project_id, freelancer_id, is_contracted, applied_at) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{userId}, false, NOW())
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM project_applications WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND freelancer_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT user_type FROM users WHERE user_id = #{userId}

SELECT project_id as projectId, client_id as clientId, title, description, start_date as startDate, deadline_date as deadlineDate, est_duration as estDuration, budget, communicate_method as communicateMethod, payment_method as paymentMethod, change_policy as changePolicy, max_revision_count as maxRevisionCount, project_status as projectStatus, is_public as isPublic, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt, view_count as viewCount, applicant_count as applicantCount, plan_url as planUrl, file_size as fileSize, budget_negotiable as budgetNegotiable, duration_negotiable as durationNegotiable FROM projects WHERE project_id = #{projectId}

SELECT project_id as projectId, client_id as clientId, title, description, start_date as startDate, deadline_date as deadlineDate, est_duration as estDuration, budget, communicate_method as communicateMethod, payment_method as paymentMethod, change_policy as changePolicy, max_revision_count as maxRevisionCount, project_status as projectStatus, is_public as isPublic, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt, view_count as viewCount, applicant_count as applicantCount, plan_url as planUrl, file_size as fileSize, budget_negotiable as budgetNegotiable, duration_negotiable as durationNegotiable FROM projects WHERE client_id = #{clientId} AND project_status = 'READY'
SELECT u.user_id as id, u.name, u.email FROM project_applications pa INNER JOIN users u ON u.user_id = pa.freelancer_id WHERE pa.project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY pa.applied_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE projects SET project_status = #{projectStatus}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE project_id = #{projectId}
